a.xlink:title:
raw_events
Engine: ReplicatedMergeTree('/clickhouse/tables/{shard}/clickstream/raw_events', '{replica}') Partition: toYYYYMM(event_time) Order by: (event_time, user_id, session_id) TTL: toDateTime(event_time) + INTERVAL 30 DAY DELETE

invalid_events
Engine: ReplicatedMergeTree('/clickhouse/tables/{shard}/clickstream/invalid_events', '{replica}') Partition: toYYYYMM(received_time) Order by: (received_time, error_code) TTL: toDateTime(received_time) + INTERVAL 30 DAY DELETE

valid_events
Engine: ReplicatedMergeTree('/clickhouse/tables/{shard}/clickstream/valid_events', '{replica}') Partition: toYYYYMM(event_time) Order by: (event_time, user_id, session_id)

prepared_events
Engine: ReplicatedReplacingMergeTree('/clickhouse/tables/{shard}/clickstream/prepared_events', '{replica}', prepared_time) Partition: toYYYYMM(event_time) Order by: (dedup_key)

kpi_daily
Engine: ReplicatedReplacingMergeTree('/clickhouse/tables/{shard}/analytics/kpi_daily', '{replica}', calculated_at) Partition: toYYYYMM(day) Order by: (day)

pages_daily
Engine: ReplicatedReplacingMergeTree('/clickhouse/tables/{shard}/analytics/pages_daily', '{replica}', calculated_at) Partition: toYYYYMM(day) Order by: (day, page_url)

session_quality_daily
Engine: ReplicatedReplacingMergeTree('/clickhouse/tables/{shard}/analytics/session_quality_daily', '{replica}', calculated_at) Partition: toYYYYMM(day) Order by: (day)

referrer_daily
Engine: ReplicatedReplacingMergeTree('/clickhouse/tables/{shard}/analytics/referrer_daily', '{replica}', calculated_at) Partition: toYYYYMM(day) Order by: (day, referrer)

user_cohorts_daily
Engine: ReplicatedReplacingMergeTree('/clickhouse/tables/{shard}/analytics/user_cohorts_daily', '{replica}', calculated_at) Partition: toYYYYMM(day) Order by: (day)

raw_events_kafka
Engine: Kafka Settings: kafka_broker_list: 'kafka-1:9092,kafka-2:9092,kafka-3:9092' kafka_topic_list: 'clickstream-events-raw' kafka_group_name: 'ch_raw_ingest' kafka_format: 'JSONAsString' kafka_num_consumers: 1 kafka_handle_error_mode: 'stream'

session_metrics_5m
Engine: ReplicatedSummingMergeTree('/clickhouse/tables/{shard}/clickstream/session_metrics_5m', '{replica}') Partition: toYYYYMM(window_start) Order by: (window_start, session_id, user_id)
